name: Elite
strategy: Improve existing Units through Accurate, Critical, Tough, Brace, and suppression of defensive reroll keywords, without broadly increasing Attack dice.

commands.name: Veteran Spearhead
commands.effect: Choose one friendly Elite Unit. Its next Melee Attack this Phase gains Critical 1 without a Surge, as this is a CP-paid Command. Elite Units include Elite, Elite Infantry, Elite Cavalry, and Elite Ranged Infantry tags.

commands.name: Find the Opening
commands.effect: One friendly Unit gains Accurate 2 on its next Attack this Phase.

commands.name: Perfect Technique
commands.effect: One friendly Unit gains Accurate 1 on its next Attack this Phase. Against that Attack, reduce the defender's effective Tough X and Cover X by 2 each, minimum zero. Suppressing Cover rerolls does not remove Cover-granted Evade eligibility.

commands.name: Combat Training
commands.effect: One friendly Unit gains Tough 1 and Brace 1 until the end of the Round.

commands.name: Knightly Order
commands.effect: One friendly Unit gains Charge 1 and Impact 1 on its next Charge this Phase.

doctrineIdentity: Disciplined, keyword-focused precision and defense; unlike Gambit, Elite does not use Reckless for additional Attack volume.
